description: Source code for managing internationalization (i18n) commands in Mattermost, including extracting, checking, and cleaning translation strings.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Represents a translation entry with an ID and translation content.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Represents a translation item with an ID and raw JSON translation.

methods.name: extractCmdF
methods.description: Handles the 'extract' command: extracts translation strings from source code and updates en.json.

methods.name: checkCmdF
methods.description: Handles the 'check' command: compares source code translation strings with en.json to identify discrepancies.

methods.name: checkEmptySrcCmdF
methods.description: Checks en.json for empty translation strings.

methods.name: cleanEmptyCmdF
methods.description: Removes empty translations from translation files.

methods.name: getBaseFileSrcStrings
methods.description: Reads and unmarshals the base en.json translation file into a list of Translation objects.

methods.name: resolveSymlink
methods.description: Resolves a path if it's a symlink, otherwise returns the original path.

methods.name: extractSrcStrings
methods.description: Walks through source directories to extract translation keys used in source code.

methods.name: addDynamicallyGeneratedStrings
methods.description: Adds predefined dynamic translation keys to the set of translation strings.

methods.name: extractByFuncName
methods.description: Extracts translation keys from function call expressions based on function name and arguments.

methods.name: extractForConstants
methods.description: Extracts translation keys from constant declarations.

methods.name: extractFromPath
methods.description: Parses Go source files to find translation keys used in code.

methods.name: countEmptyItems
methods.description: Counts and reports empty translation strings in en.json.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Removes empty translations from a translation JSON file.

methods.name: removeEmptyTranslations
methods.description: Filters out empty translation entries from a list.

methods.name: JSONMarshal
methods.description: Encodes data into JSON with indentation and HTML escaping disabled.
